ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2., the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..

2. When learning Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.

3. When learning D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.

4. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.

5. When learning Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Magnetism.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Magnetism.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Magnetism.

6. When learning Electro- Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electro- Magnetism.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electro- Magnetism.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Electro- Magnetism.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electro- Magnetism.

7. When learning Cells and Batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cells and Batteries.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cells and Batteries.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cells and Batteries.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Cells and Batteries.

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

9. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Ignore burnt cables

11. When learning Introduction to Electricity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Electricity.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Electricity.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Electricity.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Electricity.

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electricity 3.2 Equipment at the Co and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
